findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account_review, explain_change, propose_campaign · Private data: crm_status, explain_change, propose_change, record_idea, make_report · Public sink: get_account_review, propose_campaign, send_to_ad, make_report · Destructive: explain_change, test_idea, propose_campaign, get_creative_strategy, get_competitor_ads, get_market_insights, remove_competitor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account_review, explain_change, propose_campaign · Private data: crm_status, explain_change, propose_change, record_idea, make_report · Public sink: get_account_review, propose_campaign, send_to_ad, make_report · Destructive: explain_change, test_idea, propose_campaign, get_creative_strategy, get_competitor_ads, get_market_insights, remove_competitor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
